summary: Comprehensive e2e testing of new Mess & Inventory Management module (Phase 1 MVP). Backend: 22/23 pytest tests passed (1 skipped — no seeded user with role outside MESS_VIEW_ROLES). Frontend: /mess loads, all 6 tabs switch, all data-testids present, 8+ KPI cards render real values, pending receipts show approve/reject buttons. Existing modules (/api/transactions, /api/payroll-batches, /api/approvals/pending) remain 200 for admin — no regression.

design_issues.screen: Mess dialogs (Add Item / New Receipt / Record Consumption)
issues: Accessibility warning: <DialogContent> missing `aria-describedby` / <DialogDescription>. Add a hidden DialogDescription inside each Dialog to clear the a11y lint warning.

action_items: (Low) Add DialogDescription inside Add Item, New Goods Receipt, and Record Consumption/Wastage dialogs to satisfy Radix a11y warning.

(Info) No seeded user currently has a role outside MESS_VIEW_ROLES — `hr@finance.app` actually resolves to role=manager (allowed). Consider seeding a dedicated `hr`/`center_staff` user if you want the 'unauthorized role' RBAC assertion covered automatically. Backend code is correct — `require_role(*MESS_VIEW_ROLES)` rejects roles outside the whitelist; verified via code review.

(Info / not a bug) Duplicate-invoice guard matches on (center_id + supplier_name + invoice_no, status!=rejected). If `supplier_name` is left blank on both receipts, duplicate guard still fires (both compared as ''). Expected behavior; documented for E1.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 27,167 lines — Mess module (~580 lines) should ideally live in a dedicated router module (e.g. /app/backend/routers/mess.py) for maintainability (not blocking).

Rollback in mess_post_consumption restores stock qty/value via raw $inc, but the balance_qty/balance_value on prior ledger rows (deleted later) are correct because `delete_many({ref_id})` wipes them. Logic is sound.
_mess_apply_issue uses atomic conditional update ({qty: {$gte: qty_base}}) — correctly prevents negative stock even under race.
mess_approve_receipt properly blocks re-approve (status check) → no duplicate finance txn. Verified end-to-end.
Dashboard cost_per_person uses consumption_cost / meals (not purchases) — correct; avoids double counting with mess expense totals.
Partner & center_manager RBAC: _mess_center_query + _mess_assert_center correctly return 403 for out-of-scope center_id and empty [] for scoped users with no centers.

GET /api/transactions projection drops `mess_receipt_id` field from response (observed via curl). Not a bug for the mess module, but if the frontend ever wants to link an expense back to the receipt, this field must be surfaced.
